brand-on-dark.$description: Small red TEXT on dark surfaces only. 4.5:1 on #242830, the lightest dark surface in use, and more on every darker one. The identity red #DA291C stays the colour for the logo, fills, borders and large text, which need only 3:1.

brand-on-light.$description: Small red TEXT on light surfaces only. 4.87:1 on #EFEEE9 and 5.32:1 on #F8F8F4. No single red clears 4.5:1 on both surface families: the luminance window is empty for any hue, so this is two tokens by arithmetic, not by preference.

warning-on-light.$description: Warning text on light surfaces. 5.45:1 on #EFEEE9, the darkest light surface in use. Theme author's value — the 2017 brand book prices no status colours.

warning-on-dark.$description: Warning text on dark surfaces. 7.93:1 on #242830, the lightest dark surface in use. Theme author's value — the 2017 brand book prices no status colours.

success-on-light.$description: Success text on light surfaces. 5.30:1 on #EFEEE9, the darkest light surface in use. Theme author's value — the 2017 brand book prices no status colours.

success-on-dark.$description: Success text on dark surfaces. 7.60:1 on #242830, the lightest dark surface in use. Theme author's value — the 2017 brand book prices no status colours.

paper.$description: Base page surface. Warm-tinted rather than pure #fff, which reads flat beside the cream band and the dark sections.

5.$description: Labels and secondary text. Lowest step that clears 4.5:1 on every dark band in use.

6.$description: Body copy. 0.45 lands at 4.3:1 on #111318, just under the floor.

7.$description: Decorative only — below the contrast floor for text.

3.$description: Lowest step that clears 4.5:1 on the cream band.

1.$description: Hairlines on dark surfaces, strongest to faintest.
Raised panels on dark surfaces. Elevation comes from lightness, never shadow.

a1.$description: Brand red at reduced opacity, strongest to faintest.

primary.$description: Identity red. Logo, fills, borders and large text. Not small text — use the on-dark or on-light variant there.

primary-on-dark.$description: Small red text on a dark surface.

primary-on-light.$description: Small red text on a light surface.

on-surface.$description: Primary text on the base surface.

on-surface-muted.$description: Secondary text on the base surface.

outline.$description: Hairlines and dividers on light surfaces.

error-on-light.$description: Error text on a light surface. Deliberately the brand red: a second red would ask the reader to tell two reds apart, and status is never signalled by colour alone.

error-on-dark.$description: Error text on a dark surface. See error-on-light.

warning-on-light.$description: Warning text on a light surface.

warning-on-dark.$description: Warning text on a dark surface.

success-on-light.$description: Success text on a light surface.

success-on-dark.$description: Success text on a dark surface.

sans.$description: tebin.pro ships no webfont, so this resolves to Helvetica or Arial in practice. Deliberate — do not add a font request to make Roboto win.

condensed.$description: Same: no webfont is loaded on public pages, so this resolves to the visitor's system sans unless they happen to have Roboto Condensed installed. Only the og-preview/* pages request the real face, because the OG screenshots must render in it.

h1.$description: Set in the condensed face at weight 700, leading 1.35. The value is the ceiling of a fluid range, not a fixed size: display type is sized against the locale with the longest words, because a vw size that fitted English overlapped the next column by 343px in German.

h2.$description: Ceiling of a fluid range sized against the longest-word locale. See h1.

h3.$description: Ceiling of a fluid range sized against the longest-word locale. See h1.

h4.$description: Ceiling of a fluid range sized against the longest-word locale. See h1.

h5.$description: Ceiling of a fluid range sized against the longest-word locale. See h1.

body.$description: Body copy is a fixed size with leading 1.7. Running text is not display type and does not scale with the viewport.

label-sm.$description: Small uppercase label. Fixed: a label this size does not scale. Measured 2026-08-27 over the 612 uppercase rule blocks on tebin.pro that set a fixed size — 9, 10 and 11px cover 72% of them. Tracking is deliberately not a token: the same measurement found 20 tracking values with no winner, so tracking is chosen per role, not per size.

label-md.$description: Default uppercase label. Fixed. See label-sm for the measurement and for why tracking is not tokenised.

label-lg.$description: Large uppercase label. Fixed. See label-sm for the measurement and for why tracking is not tokenised.

gutter.$description: Page gutter. Ceiling of a fluid range.

section-compact.$description: Vertical rhythm between tight sections. Ceiling of a fluid range.

section-standard.$description: The default band spacing. Ceiling of a fluid range.

section-feature.$description: Around a feature band. Ceiling of a fluid range.

backgroundColor.$description: The everyday action is ink, not red. Most screens carry one of these and no red at all.

padding.$description: Horizontal. The vertical size comes from height.

height.$description: Expand the hit area to 44px on touch if the visual stays this size.

backgroundColor.$description: Red is the colour of commitment — submitting, publishing, sending. Never a casual action.

borderColor.$description: Beyond the DESIGN.md property set, which names no border. A quiet button is its border, so the token stays.
A 2px rule. The editorial CTA is a bordered word, not a filled button.

rounded.$description: Square on purpose. The site's CTA takes no radius.

padding.$description: Two values: this component sets its own vertical padding rather than a height.
